# 26.5.6 [Alpha]
More bug fixes for some really bad code I wrote... sorry lol.

## [Improvements]

- Minor updates to credits.

## [Fixes]
- Stability improvements for some editor features.
- Minor translation changes.
- Fix for inconsistency with particle despawn in arcade.
- Fix for some issues with parenting of objects in editor.

### Please don't report any parenting / weird issues with alpha unless you're sure you're on this latest build please as I want to ensure there's no regressions! Appreciate all the help so far with testing and ironing out the remaining issues~
